fields.Name: T142 - MCP Test Tool Wizard Steps
fields.Description: Exercises the flagship inline Test Tool wizard (TestStep select/configure/results state machine) — a bespoke multi-step dialog unlike any generic form or grid interaction.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT Ctrl+K), open the MCP section, then go to the Tools tab. Click the 'Test Tool' button in the header to open the 'Test MCP Tool' dialog. Confirm the dialog shows a three-step wizard with a step indicator reading '1. Select', '2. Configure', '3. Results', and that the Select step presents Server, Connection, and Tool selectors (with a tool search box). Seeing the multi-step Test Tool wizard render on the Select step is success — you do NOT need to pick a real tool or actually execute anything (there may be no servers/connections configured). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Test MCP Tool' dialog opens with a visible step indicator showing 1. Select, 2. Configure, 3. Results
The Select step shows Server, Connection, and Tool selection controls (dropdowns plus a tool search box)
The dialog has Next and Cancel actions and can be closed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
